_meta.description: National Squib principal particulars used by the simulator. Every value carries a source id (see docs/SOURCES.md) and a confidence tag: V verified from primary, S(p) primary document seen only via search excerpt, S secondary, E estimated, N not established.
_meta.toVerify: All S(p) values must be re-checked against NSOA Class Rules 2025 (docs/MISSING_INFORMATION.md B1).

minBoatMass.note: Minimum weight including sails and mandatory items

mainArea.note: Main + jib = 16.5 m2 conflicts with 15.8 m2 upwind total (C6)

mastLength.note: Datum (overall or above deck) not established

boomOuterPoint.note: Used as mainsail foot length; whether min or max is unclear
